answer: Before payout, the chain shards every answer into overlapping 7-word shingles and collapses any pair whose Jaccard similarity exceeds 0.42 into one principal. Only the earliest txid in that cluster is paid; later copies forfeit a 120 POA bond. Co-spend graphs are then merged, and the nth key in a cluster posts 40*n^2 POA that unbonds after five sealed epochs. A farm can park a knoll of paraphrased clones, yet they share one shingle set and one bill. At dawn the excess is burned, and refunds sit on a public ledge until the lock expires.
